## Runs 6 and 7 — field-cut review before the Landau fan (plan steps 3–4)

Raw sr1 X is plotted first, then signed V/I using the measured drain current, then window-dependent spectra. Run 6 is complete (921 points, 120.36 min): I = 9.843–9.935 nA, signed R = −32.95…529.63 Ω; run 7 is complete (486 points, 95.68 min): I = 9.809–9.931 nA, R = −0.38…586.87 Ω. Sample T = 1.165–1.292 K; maximum absolute TG/BG currents are 123/117 pA (6), 216/120 pA (7), with no clipping at 50 µV. Negative longitudinal X is retained: finite-field contact mixing and phase effects cannot be excluded without opposite-field data.

For run 6 the 2–10 T spectrum peaks near 7.5, 15, 22.5 and 30 T (true window resolution 2.5 T); these may include harmonics, so four peaks do not establish four pockets. Run 7 has features near 5 and 12.5 T, with strong window dependence. The automatic onset helper reports a low-edge-censored 0.7 T component in both cuts, with harmonic/residual flags; this is not a reliable measured onset or an electron-temperature determination. Both runs establish useful oscillatory signal and justify the fan. Prior proposal model frequencies/masses were predictions without an accompanying reproducible model in this handoff and are not adopted as evidence.

**Next:** step 4 maps both carrier signs on the empirical nominal D = 0 line, retaining a zero-field row and sampling 2–10 T for density-dependent branches and possible crossings. The lower-field cuts remain the high-resolution onset record. Run 5 calibrates only the capacitance ratio; its density scale remains anchored to geometry, and its resistance-minimum D origin is provisional. Test fan spacing and branch origins before assigning filling factors; the two CNP ridges could arise from different densities within the same B_1–B_2 measurement. Current stacking verdict for this sole wired voltage pair: **cannot tell (weak)**.

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_fft, sdh_onset
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
for j, rid in enumerate((6,7)):
    r = open_run(f'data/{rid}')
    ch = resolve_channels(r.meta); ci = current_channel(ch); cv = next(c for c in ch if c.cid=='sr1')
    I = r.col(ci.col)/ci.gain; V = r.col(cv.col)/cv.gain; R = V/I; B=r.col('magnet_field')
    ax[0,j].plot(B,V*1e6); ax[0,j].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Raw sr1 X (uV)',title=f'Run {rid}')
    ax[1,j].plot(B,R); ax[1,j].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Signed V/I (ohm)')
    for low in (1.5,2,3):
        f,a=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(low,10),log=False,nfft=4096,bg_degree=3)
        peaks,_=find_peaks(a[0]); peaks=sorted([p for p in peaks if 3<f[p]<70],key=lambda p:a[0,p],reverse=True)[:5]
        print('FFT',rid,'window',low,10,'resolution',1/(1/low-1/10),'peaks',[(round(f[p],2),round(a[0,p],1)) for p in peaks])
        ax[2,j].plot(f,a[0]/max(a[0]),label=f'{low}-10 T')
    ax[2,j].set(xlim=(0,70),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='FFT normalized'); ax[2,j].legend()
    print('RUN',rid,'rows',r.rows,'interrupted',r.interrupted,'minutes',(r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'])/60,'R range',R.min(),R.max(),'I nA',np.min(I)*1e9,np.max(I)*1e9,'T',np.min(r.col('T_sample')),np.max(r.col('T_sample')),'leak pA',[(x,np.max(np.abs(r.col(x)))*1e12) for x in ['k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr']])
    try: print('ONSET',rid,sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=0.7,r_full_scale=5000).summary())
    except ValueError as e: print('ONSET unassigned',rid,str(e))
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('hera_scratch/spot_review.png',dpi=150)
for rid in (0,1,2,3,5,6,7):
    r=open_run(f'data/{rid}'); dt=np.diff(r.col('time')); print('TIMING',rid,'duration min',(r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'])/60,'median dt',np.median(dt),'p90',np.quantile(dt,.9),'delay',r.meta.get('delay',r.meta.get('fast_delay')))
plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan across both carrier signs at nominal D = 0

> **05:22** · Landau fan B\_1-B\_2: nominal D=0, n=-1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2 (111); B=0 then 2..10 T (65 uniform inverse-B rows); Si=0 V, base T, 3 s dwell · **ETA ~14:37** (≈9h15m)

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`), following runs 5–7 and ana cells 14–15: both spot cuts show oscillatory signal, but their FFT peaks include possible harmonics and cannot decide stacking. Map density-dependent branch origins and crossings on the only wired voltage pair B_1–B_2; the second CNP ridge is a possible density-inhomogeneity confound. Use run 5's measured capacitance ratio and empirical D origin; density remains geometry-anchored and D=0 is provisional, to be tested by the fan rather than asserted as fully calibrated.

The first B=0 row rechecks the device after handoff, followed by 65 field rows uniformly spaced in 1/B from 2 to 10 T; density increases along each row from −1.2 to +3.2 ×10¹² cm⁻² in 0.04 steps. Gate endpoints are TG −0.277…+0.984 V and BG −0.465…+1.166 V (exact values printed below). Dwell 3 s honors 10× the measured 0.3 s lock-in time constant, with unchanged 24 dB/oct filters. sr1 is set to 100 µV for 10 kΩ nominal headroom; current is measured independently. Every followed channel is plotted, including phase, leakage, temperatures and actual gate/field readbacks.

**Coverage trade:** this map excludes 0<B<2 T, which is densely covered only at the two spot densities in runs 6/7; extending to 0.7 T at the same inverse-field spacing would add ~149 rows (~16 h of gate acquisition). The small density tails to the TG boundaries are omitted for margin. At 2 T, a fourfold LL density period has ~4.8 samples; the inverse-field spacing resolves a 40 T tone with four samples/period, but higher harmonics may alias. This is one nominal D and positive field only, with no Hall pair: those are explicit limits on a stacking call.

**Timing and checkpoints:** run 5 measured 1.098 s/point with 1 s dwell; allow 3.3 s/point here for 7326 points, plus 10 T/(1/7.3 T/min) = 73 min of blocking magnet ramps, ~10 min turnarounds/settles and 10–15% overhead. Inspect first five points, the zero-B row, first two finite-field rows, then every ~30 min and at 3/6/10 T. Continue only with live current/voltage, unrailed channels, leakage below the existing 1 nA trip and stable base T; all points have automatic guards. Lack of a separable fan is a resolution-limited result, not a stacking label. On a trip, hold gates and stop the sweep; do not auto-park or change safety limits. **Rig-specific:** kernel interrupt does not stop an in-flight CAEN ramp; the supply continues to its last target, so notify Zack and re-read actual state before recovery.

Preconditions print expected versus actual: exact committed validators/caps, wiring, fresh sample/vaporizer logs, heaters off, base T, zero-field handoff, Si zero/RNGE 2/output on, gate pacing, lock-in drive/tau/filter and Keithley state. No safety or pacing is modified. Finish at 10 T and the electron endpoint so a follow-up can ride down.

# Plan step 4: Landau fan, run-5 empirical gate line, geometry-anchored density.
# Preconditions are read-only; fail before any set if inherited state mismatches.
import json
from pathlib import Path

def fan_expect(label, actual, expected, ok):
    print(f'{label}: actual={actual}, expected={expected}')
    assert ok, f'FAN PRECONDITION FAIL: {label}'

for _p, _limits in [(k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)), (k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),
                    (dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)), (dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),
                    (magnet.field,(-10.,10.)), (heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),
                    (heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    _actual=(float(_p.vals._min_value),float(_p.vals._max_value))
    fan_expect(_p.full_name+' validator',_actual,_limits,_actual==_limits)
fan_expect('session caps',(B_SESSION_CAP,T_SESSION_CAP),(10.,100.),B_SESSION_CAP==10. and T_SESSION_CAP==100.)
_card_wiring={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2',
              'sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
fan_expect('wiring',WIRING,_card_wiring,WIRING==_card_wiring)
fan_expect('gate aliases',(k_tg.name,k_bg.name,k_si.full_name),'card role bindings',
           k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage)
for _name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
_Ts,_Tv,_B0=T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field()
fan_expect('sample T',_Ts,'1.0..1.5 K',1.0<=_Ts<=1.5)
fan_expect('vaporizer T',_Tv,'0<T<1.6 K, within 0.6 K of sample',0<_Tv<1.6 and abs(_Ts-_Tv)<0.6)
_hr=(heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range())
fan_expect('heater ranges',_hr,(0,0),_hr==(0,0))
fan_expect('handoff B',_B0,'0 T +/-0.02 T',abs(_B0)<0.02)
_ps=(magnet.persistent_switch_on(),magnet.output_enabled())
fan_expect('magnet switch/output',_ps,(True,True),all(_ps))
_si=(dc205.voltage_range(),dc205.output(),k_si(),dc205.ramp_rate)
fan_expect('Si range/output/voltage/rate',_si,'2 / on / 0 V / 0.5 V/s',_si[0]==2 and _si[1]==1 and abs(_si[2])<0.01 and _si[3]==0.5)
_steps=(k_tg.volt.step,k_bg.volt.step)
fan_expect('gate steps',_steps,(0.005,0.005),_steps==(0.005,0.005))
print('gate start readback',k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),'V; cell will set both gates')
assert_keithley_state(k_tg,rangei=1.05e-6)
assert_keithley_state(k_bg,rangei=1.05e-6)
_nplc=(k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
fan_expect('NPLC',_nplc,(1.,1.),_nplc==(1.,1.))
_drive=(sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency())
fan_expect('drive amplitude/frequency',_drive,'1 V / 13.777 Hz',abs(_drive[0]-1.)<1e-6 and abs(_drive[1]-13.777)<0.01)
_taus=(sr0.time_constant(),sr1.time_constant())
_slopes=(sr0.filter_slope(),sr1.filter_slope())
fan_expect('lock-in tau',_taus,(0.3,0.3),_taus==(0.3,0.3))
fan_expect('lock-in filter slopes',_slopes,(24,24),_slopes==(24,24))
_sens0=sr0.sensitivity()
fan_expect('current sensitivity',_sens0,0.02,_sens0==0.02)
fan_expect('channel metadata',(meas_config['sr0_gain'],meas_config['bias_resistor'],meas_config['bias_channel']),
           'gain -1e6 / 100 Mohm / sr1',meas_config['sr0_gain']==-1e6 and meas_config['bias_resistor']==100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel']=='sr1')

# SI conversion, avoiding mixed units in gate helpers. JSON offsets are e12/cm2 and V/nm.
_fan_cal=json.loads(Path('hera_scratch/cal_run5.json').read_text())
assert _fan_cal['run']==5
_nvec=np.linspace(-1.2,3.2,111)
_charge=cst.e*(_nvec-_fan_cal['n_offset'])*1e16
_diff=2*cst.epsilon_0*(0.-_fan_cal['D_offset'])*1e9
_vtg=(_charge+_diff)/(2*_fan_cal['c_tg'])
_vbg=(_charge-_diff)/(2*_fan_cal['c_bg'])
_Bvec=np.r_[0.,field_invB(2.,10.,65)]
for _p,_v in [(k_tg.volt,_vtg),(k_bg.volt,_vbg),(magnet.field,_Bvec)]:
    for _x in _v: _p.validate(float(_x))
assert np.all(np.diff(_Bvec)>0)
print('FAN grid:',len(_Bvec),'rows x',len(_nvec),'points;',
      'TG endpoints',_vtg[[0,-1]],'BG endpoints',_vbg[[0,-1]],'B endpoints',_Bvec[[0,-1]])

# Sensitivity is acquisition state, not a safety limit; no pacing/validators touched.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
_sens1=sr1.sensitivity()
assert _sens1==100e-6
mc=dict(meas_config)
mc.update({'Si (V)':_si[2],'sample_temperature:':_Ts,'sr1_gain':1.,
           'gate_calibration_run5':_fan_cal,'density_units':'1e12 cm^-2; geometry-anchored',
           'nominal_density_vector':_nvec.tolist(),'nominal_D_V_per_nm':0.,
           'lockin_tau_s':list(_taus),'lockin_filter_dB_oct':list(_slopes),
           'tg_nplci':_nplc[0],'bg_nplci':_nplc[1],
           'comments':'landau-fan: B1-B2, D nominal 0, n -1.2..3.2e12 in .04; B=0 then 65 uniform inverse-B rows 2..10 T; Si 0; 3s dwell; sr1 100uV; cal run5'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('Plan step 4; B_1-B_2; nominal D=0 V/nm, n=-1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2 (111); B=0 plus 2..10 T (65 uniform-in-1/B); TG/BG co-swept; Si=0 V; base T; run-5 ratio, geometry absolute scale; 3s dwell, 3s row settle; sr1=100uV')
s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(_vtg[0])); s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(_vbg[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
# Layout: time,Bset,TGset,BGset,Ts,Tv,Itg,Ibg,X0,P0,X1,P1,Bread,TGread,BGread.
_follow=[T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P,
         magnet.field,k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt]
for _p in _follow:
    s.fp(_p)
    s.plot('time',_p)
s.plot(k_tg.volt,magnet.field,sr1.X)
_fan_counter=[0]
_fan_trip=[]

def fan_guard(station,data):
    _a=np.asarray(data,dtype=float)
    _reasons=[]
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(_a)): _reasons.append('nonfinite readback')
    if not (1.0<=_a[4]<=1.5 and 0<_a[5]<1.6 and abs(_a[4]-_a[5])<0.6): _reasons.append('base temperature')
    if max(abs(_a[6]),abs(_a[7]))>1e-9: _reasons.append('existing 1nA leakage trip')
    _I=_a[8]/mc['sr0_gain']
    if not 0.5e-8<_I<1.5e-8: _reasons.append('drain current outside 5..15nA')
    if abs(_a[8])>=0.9*_sens0 or abs(_a[10])>=0.9*_sens1: _reasons.append('lock-in headroom <10%')
    if abs(_a[12]-_a[1])>0.03: _reasons.append('field tracking >30mT')
    if abs(_a[13]-_a[2])>0.01 or abs(_a[14]-_a[3])>0.01: _reasons.append('gate tracking >10mV')
    if _fan_counter[0]%len(_nvec)==0:
        try:
            for _name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
                assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
        except Exception as _e: _reasons.append('thermometry stale: '+str(_e))
    _fan_counter[0]+=1
    if _fan_counter[0] in (5,len(_nvec)) or _reasons:
        print('FAN CHECK',_fan_counter[0],'B',_a[12],'I_nA',_I*1e9,'sr1_X_uV',_a[10]*1e6,'issues',_reasons,flush=True)
    if _reasons:
        _fan_trip.extend(_reasons)
        station.interrupt_requested=True
        print('FAN STOP: inspect actual state; no automatic recovery. CAEN can continue last commanded ramp.',flush=True)
s.register_run_after(fan_guard,())
_fan_result=s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[_Bvec],[k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],[_vtg,_vbg],
                            slow_delay=3.,fast_delay=3.)
print('FAN COMPLETE run',_fan_result.id,'B',magnet.field(),'TG',k_tg.volt(),'BG',k_bg.volt(),
      'Si',k_si(),'Ts',T_sample(),'Tv',T_vaporizer())

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
